voluntary, weakly: no act states whether participation was chosen or imposed. Every contract is the traveller's own declaration and promise («Accepi ego quidem Pelrus Teu pulus de confinio Sancti Hermachore cum meis heredibus in collegancia de te», no. 334 (I, 330)), and none mentions compulsion. The state's role the acts do record is licensing the voyage («secundum licentiam domini ducis et consilii», e.g. no. 677 (II, 213)), not participation. Further acts outside the frequency tie the arrangement's duration to the parties' joint will: no. 13 (I, 12) «usque dum nostre in unum conveniunt volumpltates»; nos. 106 (I, 107), 270 (I, 265); and the release no. 142 (I, 141) «si vestre in unum convenissent voluntates». Alternative reading: .NR, since no clause asks the question; recommend .NR if analyst-imposed values from contract form are not wanted. allocation: the contract assigns the peril to the two named contributors in proportion to what each put in: «Et si, quid absil, a mari vel a gente suprascriptum habere perditum fuerit et eril clarefactum, nichil inde pars parti inquirere debeat, Si vero aliquid inde remanserit sicut iactavimus ita participemus» (no. 334 (I, 330)); «in nostro periculo maris el genlis» (no. 533 (II, 73)). Two recited loss events show the loss lying where the contract put it: the 1171 seizure by the emperor Manuel (nos. 380 (I, 373) and 418 (I, 409), one contract) and the Pisan seizure of a compagnia's goods (no. 787 (II, 313)). .NR: no act read speaks to loss from price movement or failed sale as distinct from loss to the peril. The loss clauses name sea and people (a mare vel a gente) and the remainder after such a loss. The clause «capitanea salva. prode vero quod inde Dominus dederit» (no. 334 (I, 330)) says capital comes before profit is divided; it does not say who bears a shortfall in capital from trading. Alternative reading, not adopted: that capitanea salva plus the duty to return the whole capital puts market loss on the traveller (labour-provider), or that the remainder clause («Si vero aliquid inde remanserit sicut iactavimus ita participemus», no. 334) extends to any shortfall (shared). Both read past the text.
